assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope.
The patient has transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias.
The monitoring is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies.
The monitoring is essential for evaluating the clinical indication.
Diagnosis code R55 applies to this case.
Diagnosis code G45.9 applies to this case.
Diagnosis code I48.0 applies to this case.
